finding_title: Contracts should implement a two-step ownership transfer
impact: The neutron-staking-rewards and neutron-staking-info-proxy contracts within the scope of this audit allow the current owner to execute a one-step ownership transfer, as seen in 55 =====PAGE 56===== contracts/dao/neutron-staking-rewards/src/contract.rs:125-127 and contracts/dao/neutron-staking-info-proxy/src/contract.rs:88-90. While this is common practice, it presents a risk for the contract ownership to become lost if the owner transfers ownership to an incorrect address. A two-step ownership transfer will allow the current owner to propose a new owner, and then the account that is proposed as the new owner may call a function that will allow them to claim ownership and actually execute the conﬁg update.
raw_body_excerpt: The neutron-staking-rewards and neutron-staking-info-proxy contracts within the scope of this audit allow the current owner to execute a one-step ownership transfer, as seen in 55 =====PAGE 56===== contracts/dao/neutron-staking-rewards/src/contract.rs:125-127 and contracts/dao/neutron-staking-info-proxy/src/contract.rs:88-90. While this is common practice, it presents a risk for the contract ownership to become lost if the owner transfers ownership to an incorrect address. A two-step ownership transfer will allow the current owner to propose a new owner, and then the account that is proposed as the new owner may call a function that will allow them to claim ownership and actually execute the conﬁg update. Recommendation We recommend implementing a two-step ownership transfer. The ﬂow can be as follows: 1. The current owner proposes a new owner address that is validated. 2. The new owner account claims ownership, which applies the conﬁguration changes. Status: Acknowledged The client states that they ﬁnd this mechanism complicated and non-usable in their case since a change of owner is quite a rare event. Each transaction is being carefully reviewed, and in their case, the owner should not be changed since all contracts will be owned by the Main DAO itself.
